body:
### Question

We have just upgraded uv to >= 0.12 and observed a new behaviour in `uv export`.

More specifically, we a multi-package repo and as part of the pre-commit we run this script:

```
#!/bin/bash

uv lock

# Export dependencies for packages
if [ -d "packages" ]; then
    for dir in packages/*/; do
        if [ -d "$dir" ]; then
            package_name=$(basename "$dir")
            echo "Exporting dependencies for package: $package_name"
            uv export --frozen --no-hashes --no-annotate --package "$package_name" --output-file "$dir/requirements.txt"
        fi
    done
fi
```

Until version 0.11, this would export `requirements.txt` files inside each package folder with **only** the relevant dependencies. Whereas now all requirements.txt files have all the dependencies in the workspace.
Is that expected? And if so, why has the behaviour changed?

### Platform

_No response_

### Version

0.12.1
title: Behaviour of "uv export" in workspace
